# Graphic Design Apprentice

**Brendale, Brisbane QLD**
**Full-time Apprenticeship | Monday–Friday**

## Turn your creativity into a career.

Do you love design? Are you always creating artwork, experimenting with Adobe programs or finding yourself noticing great branding everywhere you go?

Velflex is one of Australia's leading manufacturers of custom heat transfers, supplying apparel decorators, sporting clubs, promotional product businesses and major brands across Australia and New Zealand.

We're looking for a **Graphic Design Apprentice** to join our experienced Graphics team in Brendale.

This is an incredible opportunity to gain a nationally recognised qualification while learning from experienced designers in a real production environment. You'll develop practical skills that can't be taught in a classroom, working on artwork that ends up on sportswear, uniforms, workwear, fashion and promotional products seen right across Australia.

If you're creative, motivated and excited to build a long-term career in graphic design, we'd love to hear from you.

## What you'll be learning

Working alongside our experienced Graphics team, you'll receive hands-on training in:

* Preparing customer artwork for production
* Creating and editing vector artwork using Adobe Illustrator
* Basic image editing in Adobe Photoshop
* Colour matching and artwork adjustments
* Setting up print-ready artwork files
* Understanding heat transfer and garment decoration production processes
* Digital printing workflows and production preparation
* Proofing artwork and quality control
* Managing multiple jobs and meeting production deadlines
* Working closely with our Sales, Customer Service and Production teams to achieve outstanding customer outcomes

As your skills develop, you'll have opportunities to contribute to customer artwork, branding projects, new product development and continuous improvement initiatives.

## About you

We're looking for someone who is passionate about creativity and excited to learn.

You don't need years of experience—we'll provide full training—but you do need the right attitude and a genuine interest in graphic design.

You'll be a great fit if you:

* Have a genuine passion for graphic design and creativity
* Enjoy problem solving and thinking visually
* Have an excellent eye for detail
* Take pride in producing accurate, high-quality work
* Enjoy learning new software and skills
* Are organised and able to manage multiple tasks
* Communicate well and enjoy working with others
* Are reliable, motivated and eager to build a long-term career
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment

It would be great if you also have:

* Basic knowledge of Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop (school, TAFE or personal projects all count)
* A portfolio of school work, personal projects or creative designs (not essential but highly regarded)
* Completed Year 12 (preferred but not essential)

## What you'll gain

This is much more than an apprenticeship.

You'll receive:

* A nationally recognised Graphic Design qualification
* Full on-the-job training and mentoring from experienced designers
* Experience using industry-leading Adobe Creative Cloud software
* Exposure to the latest digital print and garment decoration technology
* Real-world design experience from day one
* Opportunities to work on artwork for well-known Australian brands, sporting clubs and businesses
* A supportive team that genuinely wants to see you succeed
* Long-term career opportunities within a growing Australian company

## Why join Velflex?

Velflex is a proudly family-owned Australian business with a reputation for innovation, quality and exceptional customer service.

Our mission is to deliver industry-leading heat transfer solutions while helping our customers succeed through exceptional products, education and support.

Everything we do is guided by our core values of **Respect, Resilience, Trust, Honesty and Pride**.

When you join Velflex, you'll enjoy:

* A supportive, family-owned team culture
* Modern production and design facilities in Brendale
* On-site parking
* Barista-quality coffee every day
* Regular team BBQs, celebrations and social events
* Company uniforms provided
* Ongoing training and professional development
* Career progression opportunities as the business continues to grow

## Hours

This is a full-time apprenticeship based at our Brendale facility.

Standard hours are **Monday to Friday**, with training provided entirely on-site alongside our experienced Graphics team.

## Ready to start your creative career?

If you're passionate about design and want to turn that passion into a rewarding career, we'd love to hear from you.

Please apply with your resume and a short cover letter telling us why you'd like to become a **Graphic Design Apprentice** at Velflex.

If you have a portfolio of school projects, personal artwork or creative work, we'd love to see it—but it's not essential.

Start your design career with a team that's passionate about creativity, innovation and helping people grow.

## Telecommunications Technical Officer / Technologist
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Telecommunications Technical Officer or Technologist to join our team and contribute to the delivery of reliable, high-performance telecommunications infrastructure. This role is responsible for the design, installation, maintenance, and optimisation of complex communication networks and systems across a range of technologies. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on technical experience, strong analytical capability, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. This position suits a proactive professional who is committed to maintaining the highest standards of network performance and service delivery.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain microwave, satellite, telemetry, and other radio and electromagnetic communication systems, ensuring all equipment operates to specification and within regulatory requirements.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve network faults, performance issues, and equipment malfunctions in a timely and effective manner, minimising disruption to services.
- Integrate telecommunications networks with computer hardware, software platforms, operating systems, databases, and peripheral devices to ensure seamless end-to-end functionality.
- Monitor the ongoing performance of complex networks and communication systems, identifying trends, anomalies, and areas for optimisation before they impact service quality.
- Plan and support the development of customer access network infrastructure, contributing to capacity planning, design reviews, and upgrade programmes.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation including inventory logs, equipment records, asset statuses, and communication policies, procedures, and quality standards in accordance with organisational and regulatory guidelines.
- Provide clear technical advice and support to internal stakeholders, project teams, and end users on telecommunications systems, configurations, and best practices.
- Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and external service providers to coordinate procurement, installation activities, and ongoing service delivery, whilst monitoring contractual performance and obligations.
- Support the design and optimisation of network architecture, contributing technical input to projects aimed at improving reliability, scalability, and performance.
- Conduct routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and equipment testing to ensure network integrity and compliance with applicable standards.
- Assist in the development and review of technical documentation, including network diagrams, standard operating procedures, and incident reports.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on telecommunications projects, providing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle from scoping through to commissioning and handover.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A diploma, advanced diploma, or bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent industry experience in lieu of formal qualifications.
- Demonstrated experience in a telecommunications technical role, with hands-on exposure to radio frequency (RF), microwave, satellite, or fixed-line communication systems.
- Solid understanding of network protocols, telecommunications standards, and systems integration principles.
- Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting network hardware, software, and associated technologies including switches, routers, and transmission equipment.
- Experience with network monitoring tools and fault management systems, with the ability to interpret performance data and take corrective action.
- Strong documentation skills with the ability to maintain accurate records, produce technical reports, and adhere to quality and compliance standards.
- Effective communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work methodically under pressure, and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes.
- A valid Australian driver's licence, as field-based work and site visits may be required.
- Willingness to participate in an on-call roster or undertake out-of-hours work when operational requirements demand.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent telecommunications qualifications.
- Experience working with microwave backhaul systems, fibre optic networks, or mobile network infrastructure (2G/3G/4G/5G).
- Familiarity with Australian telecommunications regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements, including those governed by the ACMA.
- Exposure to project management methodologies and experience contributing to telecommunications infrastructure projects.
- Knowledge of ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed services or enterprise network environment.
- Postgraduate qualifications in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related discipline.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and highly skilled engineering team working on critical telecommunications infrastructure that makes a real difference to communities and businesses across Australia.
- Enjoy genuine opportunities for professional development, including access to industry training, certifications, and career progression pathways within the organisation.
- Benefit from a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, with options for hybrid arrangements where operational requirements allow.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation contributions, and access to additional employee benefits including wellness programmes and paid leave entitlements.
- Work on a diverse range of projects and technologies that will broaden your technical expertise and keep you at the forefront of the evolving telecommunications landscape.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

•	Supervise animal health programs, handle sick or injured animals and maintain an optimal environment for the wellbeing of livestock consistent with the Australian Animal Welfare Standards and Guidelines – Cattle.
•	Supervise work routines and staff performance of less experienced employees such as an assistant farmhand.
•	Implement and monitor quality assurance procedures, ensuring compliance and that all relevant documentation is kept current.
•	Operate milking plant and equipment in a safe manner, undertake multiple functions including reading and recording instrument information e.g. milk vat temperatures and cow numbers and matching cow ID to calves to produce a quality milk outcome.
•	Operate a dairy recycling system.
•	Calf feeding, including tubing colostrum
•	Assisting with and/or performing irrigation works.
•	Inspect livestock to gauge the effectiveness of feed formulae.
•	Transport, handle and store chemicals; prepare and apply chemicals.
•	Operate farm and dairy shed-related vehicles, plant and equipment.
•	Identify and report equipment not operating normally; maintenance of plant and machinery.
•	Where appropriately qualified, perform maintenance works on sheds, fixtures and fittings, fences and surrounds and install new or replacement equipment or fittings.
•	Transport stock, feed and equipment, if appropriately licensed.
•	Maintain records to ensure accurate information for stock and inventory control.
•	Ensure food safety regulatory requirements are met.
•	Contribute to and implement OHS requirements.
•	Computer literate – operate computer equipment and software packages requiring set-up and basic function operation.
•	Coordinate the response to emergencies for both occupational health and safety emergencies and animal welfare emergencies.
•	Participate in enterprise/industry training sessions and workshops as required.
